title: Preview — media quick-look
description: Quick-look media viewer. Zoomable images with dimensions + checkerboard transparency, an audio player with CSS-bar waveform/transport, a video player with play/pause + scrubber + volume, and PDF/text surfaces. Type-indicator chip, Download, and Open-in-editor handoff via an injectable opener (image → image editor, video/audio → video editor). Remote files render through an injectable media source (identity by default — public URLs just work); the bundled sample gallery is fully offline.
